source: The Pramana implementation is not yet public. It will be released once it closes a substantial part of the gap between what the design expresses and what the implementation covers.

interfaces.SHAPE: POST /shape {download_mbps, upload_mbps, latency_ms, latency_location, qdisc, buffer_packets, qdisc_params}: HTB rate on the bottleneck, netem delay
interfaces.qdiscs: POST /shape qdisc: any Linux queue discipline name, installed as the HTB leaf with qdisc_params passed through
interfaces.CAPVAR:schedule: POST /shape re-applied on a second-scale schedule (tc rate change)
interfaces.PATHVAR: POST /shape re-applied on a second-scale schedule (netem change)
interfaces.XTRACE: POST /ctp/fetch, POST /replay {ctp_file}: replays a rate-capped cross-traffic profile into the bottleneck
interfaces.CAPVAR:trace: POST /replay on a static envelope: capacity left for the workflow varies over time
interfaces.XGEN: shell workflow test_iperf_workflow (iperf3) run concurrently with the workflow under test
interfaces.XAPP: concurrent application workflows (development branch, commit below)
interfaces.PERFLOW:apps: per-application delay for browser workflows (development branch, commit below)
interfaces.APP: browser workflows from the NetGent library (22 applications), selected or generated from the intent
interfaces.TOOL:*: shell workflows: chosen from the workflow library or generated from the intent, run on the worker
interfaces.kernel_ccas: POST /congestion {algorithm}: one of 15 stock Linux modules (the CCAnalyzer set)
interfaces.INET: the worker reaches public Internet targets through the shaped bottleneck
interfaces.CLOUD:aws: aws backend (hybrid mode): provisions EC2 hosts that run substrate workers

not_provided: Multi-node topology; kernel choice per experiment (workers run as containers on a fixed host image, so they share its kernel); kernel algorithms outside the 15-module list; software built from source.
